name: Groom
logline_subject_info: The young, charming heir to a business empire, publicly appearing in love but privately devastated by his bride's coldness.
visual_desc: A photorealistic portrait of a handsome man in his late 20s, of Northern European descent. He has a sharp jawline, short, impeccably styled dark brown hair, and intelligent blue eyes behind stylish, thin black-rimmed glasses. His expression is a neutral, composed mask that barely conceals an underlying vulnerability. He wears a classic, perfectly tailored black tuxedo, a crisp white formal shirt, and a black silk bow tie. His skin is clear with a healthy complexion. EDC: A high-end, slim stainless steel watch is visible on his left wrist. His left inner jacket pocket has the slight bulge of a smartphone. The background is a solid deep-charcoal. Soft studio lighting with a faint warm side-light. Wears a classic black tuxedo with a bow tie.
video_visual_desc: Handsome man, late 20s, Northern European, dark brown hair, blue eyes, wearing stylish black-rimmed glasses and a classic black tuxedo with a bow tie. Carries a smartphone in his inner jacket pocket and wears a slim steel watch.
behavioral_signature: Under pressure: freezes, his charming facade drops to reveal confusion and hurt. He does not lash out but absorbs the emotional blow. Power move: uses grand, performative gestures of affection in public to control the perception of his relationship. Tell: adjusts his glasses on the bridge of his nose when feeling insecure or thrown off balance.
physical_vocabulary: In public, maintains an open, confident posture, deliberately closing distance with his partner for affectionate displays. In private confrontations, his body becomes still and his posture slightly slumps, anchoring him to one spot as he processes the situation. He rarely gestures when distressed, holding his hands rigidly at his sides.
